records.region: Pará, Brazil; Rio Jacundá corridor to Baía das Bocas in the Rio Pará estuarine network.
records.candidate_name_role: Supported representative identity of the downstream named river system; not a uniform name for the initial feeder or every island-side passage.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The selected group starts on an unnamed southern feeder west of the Rio dos Cajás corridor, curves northeast and then north into the named Rio Jacundá approach. It follows the connected Jacundá north, west and northwest across both Portel map sheets, then through its widening, island-bearing lower river. The selected terminal is at the northern Jacundá estuarine opening east of Ilha Mirituba and south of Ilha Jacundá, in the mapped Baía das Bocas/Rio Pará setting. The separately labelled Baía do Portel is farther west. The retained sea class is not evidence of an open-ocean coastline at this endpoint. Rio Jacundá is supported as the representative system candidate, with the headward and side-channel naming limits retained.
